Configuration objects should be registered as singletons.

Back to STXAPP rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Configuration objects should be registered as singletons. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Applications family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXAPP003: Configuration objects should be registered as singletons.
services.AddScoped<SchoolConfiguration>();

Good code example

// Follows STXAPP003
services.AddSingleton<SchoolConfiguration>();
